messages.text:
"Create a complete 2D online multiplayer strategy game called EMPIRE WARS, inspired by classic Zynga Facebook games.

The game must run in web browsers on Android phones and computers.

GAME FEATURES:

1. VILLAGE BUILDING

- Build farms, houses, castles, barracks and defense towers.
- Upgrade all buildings.
- Expand your territory.

2. RESOURCE SYSTEM

- Collect gold, wood, food and stone.
- Produce resources automatically over time.
- Use resources to build and upgrade.

3. ARMY SYSTEM

- Recruit soldiers, archers, knights, warriors and cavalry.
- Train soldiers and increase their levels.
- Upgrade weapons, armor and skills.
- Give every soldier individual statistics.

4. COMPLETE WAR SYSTEM

- Attack enemy villages.
- Defend your own village.
- Real-time battles with animated 2D soldiers.
- Different troop types with unique abilities.
- Enemy AI with intelligent strategies.
- Battle results, rewards and rankings.

5. MULTIPLAYER

- Online player accounts.
- Fight other real players.
- Create alliances and clans.
- Send troops to allies.
- Global player rankings.
- Player messaging and chat.

6. PROGRESSION

- Player levels from 1 to 100.
- Daily missions and achievements.
- Special rewards and rare equipment.
- Unlock new buildings and stronger troops.

7. GAME DESIGN

- Beautiful colorful 2D graphics.
- Classic Facebook strategy game atmosphere.
- Medieval fantasy world.
- Smooth animations.
- Easy touchscreen and mouse controls.
- Responsive mobile and desktop interface.

8. TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

- Fully playable game, not just a visual prototype.
- Save player progress and accounts.
- Functional buttons and menus.
- Persistent database for multiplayer.
- Secure player authentication.
- Turkish language support.

Build the complete game with all systems connected. Prioritize a working playable experience. Do not create placeholder buttons or fake multiplayer features.
"
